description: This file defines the 'Home' component for a furniture shopping web application using the LightningJS framework. It manages rendering of header, product cards, cart button, and checkout modal, and handles state related to products, layout, and loading/error conditions.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Base class from '@lightningjs/blits' used to create Lightning components

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes reactive state variables for the component

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Defines reactive property watchers, particularly for products, to update layoutItems when products change

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Sets up store subscriptions to update component state based on application store state

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Lifecycle method invoked on component initialization; loads products if not already loaded
